message:
[ty] Respect descriptor protocol for `__set__` itself (#28408)

## Summary

This PR properly models the fact that implicit `__set__` calls should
also go through the descriptor protocol themselves, which handles edge
cases like `__set__` methods that are `@staticmethod`s. We also add
bidirectional inference support for (more) descriptor attribute
assignments, which is where the ecosystem improvement comes from:

```py
class DataDescriptor:
    def __set__(self, instance: object, value: list[int | None]) -> None:
        pass

class Meta(type):
    x: DataDescriptor = DataDescriptor()

class C(metaclass=Meta): ...

C.x = [1]  # now accepted, previously an error (Expected `list[int | None]`, found `list[int]`)
```

closes https://github.com/astral-sh/ty/issues/4485.

## Ecosystem

25 false positives removed!
